name: Incomer Clearance Margin
description: MCCB incomers require minimum clearance margins for arc gas venting and thermal dissipation.

name: Maximum Allowable Voltage Drop
description: Standard feeder voltage drop must not exceed 3.0% under full load design current.

name: Busbar Rating Safety Margin
description: Busbar continuous current rating must be at least 125% of the incomer rated current.

name: Maximum Zone Heat Density
description: Zone heat loss density should not exceed 0.45 W/L without active forced ventilation.
